content_sections.heading: BOI Vacancy 2026 – Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: The 205 vacancies are distributed across four scales - Scale IV (Chief Manager), Scale III (Senior Manager), Scale II (Manager/Officer-level specialist roles), and Scale I (Officer). The table below lists all 48 posts with total vacancies (inclusive of backlog) and the applicable age band. Category-wise (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/GEN) and PWD/Ex-Servicemen break-up for each post is available in the official Notice dated 01.08.2026.

content_sections.heading: BOI Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: Fee is payable online only, from 10.09.2026 to 25.09.2026, via Debit/Credit Card, Internet Banking, UPI, or QR code. Bank transaction charges are borne by the candidate.

content_sections.heading: Bank of India Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: Minimum and maximum age are calculated as on 01.08.2026 and vary by post - from 21-30 years for Scale I Officer posts up to 28-42 years for Scale IV Chief Manager posts. Upper age relaxation is available as follows: SC/ST – 5 years; OBC (non-creamy layer) – 3 years; PwBD – 10 years; Ex-Servicemen/ECOs/SSCOs – 5 years; persons affected by 1984 riots – 5 years. Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly.

content_sections.heading: BOI Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Online Examination: English Language (25 marks, qualifying only) + Professional Knowledge relevant to the post (100 marks), composite duration 100 minutes Minimum qualifying marks: 35% for General/EWS (30% for SC/ST/OBC/PWD) Personal Interview: Maximum 100 marks; qualifying 50% for General/EWS, 45% for SC/ST/OBC/PWD; candidates called at approximately 1:3 ratio to vacancies Final weightage: Online Examination and Interview combined at 60:40 Bank may, at its discretion, select solely through Interview without an online exam

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Valid Interview Call Letter and printout of the online application form Proof of Date of Birth Photo Identity Proof (PAN/Passport/Driving Licence/Voter ID/Aadhaar with photo) Educational mark sheets and certificates Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC-Non-Creamy Layer/EWS/PWD), as applicable Experience certificates and mandatory certification proofs relevant to the post applied for No Objection Certificate (for candidates in government/PSU employment)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Bank of India Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official website www.bankofindia.bank.in and click on 'CAREER' Click the link "Recruitment of Officers in various streams upto Scale IV – Project No. 2026-27/02 Notice dated 01.08.2026" Click 'APPLY ONLINE' and complete new registration to generate a Provisional Registration Number and Password Fill in personal, educational, and experience details; upload photograph, signature, left thumb impression, and hand-written declaration as per specifications Preview and verify all details before clicking 'COMPLETE REGISTRATION' Pay the application fee/intimation charges online Take a printout of the system-generated application form and e-receipt for personal record

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates can apply for only one post; multiple applications will retain only the latest valid one Candidates already holding a similar post in Bank of India in the past are not eligible No change of category or other application details is permitted after registration Selected candidates must deposit a refundable security deposit: ₹1,00,000 (JMGS-I), ₹2,00,000 (MMGS-II), ₹3,00,000 (MMGS-III and above) All mandatory certifications must be valid as on 01.08.2026 Bank reserves the right to change, cancel, or modify vacancies, posts, or the selection process at any stage
